display_name: Windows generic lip-sync candidate development catalog

requirements: A separately installed and verified pack must qualify the exact SDK, regression model, licenses, Windows runtime, and GPU contention envelope.
A project-owned mapper must convert coefficients into an npc.mouth-residual/v1 output bound to current landmarks, track epoch, and source frame.
End-to-end qualification must demonstrate fail-open identity, occlusion, mask, confidence, cancellation, and one-frame staleness behavior.
constraints: Unqualified and unselectable: this entry is candidate metadata, not a bundled model, runtime, default, download, or performance claim.
Audio-to-coefficient output does not itself generate screen-space pixels and cannot replace a captured frame.
Static-avatar or native-rig demonstrations do not establish generic moving-game suitability.

requirements: User confirms private NGC access; an ordinary NVIDIA NIM API key is not sufficient.
A separately installed and verified Windows pack passes local qualification.
The media broker supplies 16 kHz audio and the required 14 source-frame pre-roll.
The exact SDK and model licenses are accepted before pack activation.
constraints: Conditional candidate only; private access and Windows qualification are unresolved for general users.
No SDK, model, download URL, credential, or resource estimate is included in this descriptor.

requirements: A separately installed and verified pack passes Windows, license, contention, freshness, and visual qualification.
Output is constrained to a tracked mouth residual bound to the exact current source frame.
constraints: Experimental candidate; public source availability does not imply live-game qualification.
No repository, model, download URL, or resource estimate is included in this descriptor.

requirements: A separately installed and verified worker pack passes tracking, freshness, occlusion, and visual qualification.
The runtime restores the untouched frame whenever confidence, identity, freshness, or cancellation checks fail.
constraints: Baseline candidate only; inclusion does not claim a quality, latency, storage, RAM, or VRAM result.
The worker contract contains no model payload and no game-specific adapter behavior.

requirements: Windows-native packaging and a safe non-pickle model path must be demonstrated before reconsideration.
License, freshness, contention, and current-frame residual qualification remain required.
constraints: Deferred because the available configuration is Linux-oriented, pickle handling is rejected, and the Windows build is unqualified.
The candidate cannot be selected or downloaded by this development catalog.

requirements: A separately installed and verified pack is explicitly selected for offline rendering only.
License and offline output provenance checks pass before activation.
constraints: Not eligible for live conversation or current-frame presentation.
No repository, model, download URL, or resource estimate is included in this descriptor.
